h: Toyin Abraham and crew kneel to welcome Pete Edochie on her film set
p: Actress Toyin Abraham and her crew reportedly went down on their knees to welcome veteran actor Pete Edochie to her film set. She also greeted him with Igbo chants.
body: Nollywood actress Toyin Abraham has drawn praise online after a video showed her welcoming veteran actor Pete Edochie to her film set.
The clip, posted on Abraham's Instagram page on Monday, 23 November 2026, captured the moment she and her crew dropped to their knees as Edochie stepped out of his vehicle.
After the greeting, Abraham launched into Igbo chants in the actor's honour, and a praise singer believed to be part of the crew joined in, singing the veteran star's praises in Igbo.
Many viewers praised the actress for the respect she showed the Nollywood icon.
Pete Edochie, one of Nollywood's most respected veterans, was in the news this week after speaking about his son, Yul Edochie.
more: Toyin and her crew knelt as Edochie arrived.
